narrative.details: Return to Marduke with the keepsake, adventurer. He will instruct you in its use.
narrative.objectives: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.
narrative.offerRewardText: I was certain that you would be joining me as another hapless spirit.

chain.subtitle: 9 quests at level 60, 62,850 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
quests.objectiveText: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.objectiveText: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
